company.name: RightHand Robotics
company.shortDescription: RightHand Robotics provides end-to-end solutions that reduce the cost of e-commerce order-fulfillment of electronics, apparel, grocery.
company.description:
RightHand Robotics provides end-to-end solutions that reduce the cost of e-commerce order-fulfillment of electronics, apparel, grocery. Their robots grasp a wide variety of items from bins and cases. Their core technology enables them to do this automatically without laborious data entry or parameter-tuning — so they are inexpensive to set up and flexible to the changing needs of businesses.

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts.

aiResearchSummary.text: RightHand Robotics is developing robotic picking devices and methods for e commerce order fulfillment. Pivotable suction cup device and method focuses on a suction device with a vacuum source and pivotable portions to grasp items. Suction device multipick detection and Suction device and apparatus address suction cup based picking with grasp attempt and multipick sensing. Finger assembly and method describes a linked finger structure for grasping items. Together these efforts target suction based and fingered robotic picking systems.
